## Overview[]

This page describes major updates for *Fallout 76*. With the online nature of the game, what were previously known as add-ons now functions as a series of updates spanning a certain period of time featuring new content. All of this content is free and is incorporated into the game.

| **Fallout 76 updates** | | 
| | *Wild Appalachia*March 13, 2019 ***Wild Appalachia*** is the first major update for*Fallout 76* .*A mythical beast, a lost generation of scouts, and the strongest brew this side of the wasteland. Welcome to Wild Appalachia – a series of new quests, features, events, crafting systems and more.* | 
| | *Nuclear Winter*June 10, 2019 ***Nuclear Winter*** is the second major update for*Fallout 76* .*Summer brings another series of major updates to Fallout 76, including Nuclear Winter - an entirely new way to play that changes the rules of the wasteland.* | 
| | *Wastelanders*April 14, 2020 ***Wastelanders*** is the third major update for*Fallout 76* .*Embark on a tale with true choice and consequences in Wastelanders – our biggest and most ambitious update for 76. Wastelanders includes a new main questline, new factions, new events, new features and even more surprises.* | 
| | *The Legendary Run*June 30, 2020 ***The Legendary Run*** is the fourth major update for*Fallout 76* .*From the makers of Unstoppables Shindig, Blast Radius, and Catch the Commie comes The Legendary Run - a new way to experience irradiated West Virginia. Each season brings a new progression of challenges to complete, plus exclusive rewards like Atom Bundles, Perk Card packs, and unique cosmetics.* | 
| | *One Wasteland For All*September 15, 2020 ***One Wasteland For All*** is the fifth major update for*Fallout 76* .*Experience all that the Appalachian Wasteland has to offer no matter your level. Rebalanced combat and rewards scale to your level so players at different levels can easily team up to experience the entire world together---from the Toxic Valley to the Cranberry Bog.* | 
| | *Steel Dawn*November 21, 2020 ***Steel Dawn*** is the sixth major update for*Fallout 76* .*The Brotherhood of Steel returns to Appalachia in search of new technology. The start of a new story arc, Steel Dawn introduces new NPCs, quests, and companions to the West Virginia Wasteland.* | 
| | *Locked & Loaded*April 27, 2021 ***Locked & Loaded*** is the seventh major update for*Fallout 76* .*Containing an all-new Season, Scoreboard and Rewards, the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. Loadouts and C.A.M.P. Slots features, a major expansion for Daily Ops, and much more!* | 
| | *Steel Reign*July 7, 2021 ***Steel Reign*** is the eighth major update for*Fallout 76* .*The next chapter in the story of the Brotherhood of Steel, picking up where Steel Dawn left off.* | 
| | *Fallout Worlds*September 8, 2021 ***Fallout Worlds*** is the ninth major update for*Fallout 76* .*The winds of change are coming, and with it an evolution to Private Worlds! We're also bringing another expansion to Daily Ops to bring you even more ways to play.* | 
| | *Night of the Moth*December 8, 2021 ***Night of the Moth*** is the tenth major update for*Fallout 76* .*Introduces The Mothman Equinox seasonal event, color settings for the Pip-Boy and quality-of-life changes to looting and Public events.* | 
| | *Invaders from Beyond*March 1, 2022 ***Invaders from Beyond*** is the eleventh major update for*Fallout 76* .*Introduces the Invaders from Beyond seasonal event, SCORE is now obtainable in Public and Custom Worlds, and backpacks can now be hidden.* | 
| | *Test Your Metal*June 14, 2022 ***Test Your Metal*** is the twelfth major update for*Fallout 76* .*Put your armor, weapons and grit to the test in multiple new-heartpounding public events. Introduces several new public events, as well as upgrades to the Fallout 1st scoreboard.* | 
| | *Expeditions: The Pitt*September 13, 2022 ***Expeditions: The Pitt*** is the thirteenth major update for*Fallout 76* .*This Expedition takes players to the irradiated ruins of Pittsburgh, now known far and wide as simply The Pitt. First introduced to players in* Fallout 3*, the devastated Pennsylvanian city has become dominated by mutated monstrosities and other threats. See what opportunities (and dangers) await in this new locale when this Expedition embarks for Fallout 76 in 2022!* | 
| | *Nuka-World on Tour*December 6, 2022 ***Nuka-World on Tour*** is the fourteenth major update for*Fallout 76* .*The fizziest show on Earth has kicked the irradiated dust of the tires and hit the road. Next stop Appalachia! Introduces new events and a new regional boss.* | 
| | *Mutation Invasion*February 28, 2023 ***Mutation Invasion*** is the fifteenth major update for*Fallout 76* .*It's no secret how the wilds of post-nuclear Appalachia got so strange – all that radiation exposure just can't be good for your DNA. In Fallout 76's latest update, even the game's Public Events are starting to mutate!* | 
| | *Once in a Blue Moon*June 20, 2023 ***Once in a Blue Moon*** is the sixteenth major update for*Fallout 76* .*The Blue Ridge Caravan is back and needs your help with their expanding business! This summer our Once in a Blue Moon update will bring you two new cryptids, Public Events, Side Quests, Rewards, a Daily Ops Mutation and more!* | 
| | *Expeditions: Atlantic City****Boardwalk Paradise***December 5, 2023 ***Boardwalk Paradise*** is the seventeenth major update for*Fallout 76* , considered the first wave of content for*Expeditions: Atlantic City* .*Prepare for high rollers and higher stakes when Fallout 76 embarks players on an all-new Expedition to Atlantic City – coming soon for all players! With so many ways to play, you too can answer the call of 76.* | 
| | *Expeditions: Atlantic City****America's Playground***March 26, 2024 ***America's Playground*** is the eighteenth major update for*Fallout 76* , considered the second wave of content for*Expeditions: Atlantic City* .*Players encountered new places – and new faces – last year with the introduction of Fallout 76's latest Expedition to Atlantic City. Next, players have some unfinished business to attend to in post-nuclear New Jersey.* | 
| | *Skyline Valley*June 12, 2024 ***Skyline Valley*** is the nineteenth major update for*Fallout 76* .*In the game's first major expansion of the world map, you'll cross the Savage Divide and travel to the southern reaches of Appalachia. This picturesque new region, Skyline Valley, introduces new locations to explore among the woodlands once known as real world Shenandoah National Park.* | 
| | *Milepost Zero*September 3, 2024 ***Milepost Zero*** is the twentieth major update for*Fallout 76* .*Take up the reigns of a ramshackle caravan outpost and transform it into a thriving enterprise with unique décor and friendly vendors offering exotic goods and services.* | 
| | *Gleaming Depths*December 3, 2024 ***Gleaming Depths*** is the twenty-first major update for*Fallout 76* .*Gather your friends and enter the Gleaming Depths for a whole new challenge and to earn the long-awaited 4-Star Legendary Weapons, Armor, and Mods. Or head to your C.A.M.P. and welcome a fuzzy friend into your space with the new C.A.M.P. Pets feature.* | 
| | *Ghoul Within*March 18, 2025 ***Ghoul Within*** is the twenty-second major update for*Fallout 76* .*Experience Fallout 76 in a 'ghoul' new way. For the first time in Fallout history, you can turn your character into a Ghoul! Isn't smooth skin overrated? Find your Ghoul Within now!* | 
| | *Gone Fission*June 3, 2025 ***Gone Fission*** is the twenty-third major update for*Fallout 76* .*Gone Fission brings fishing to Fallout 76, including an exciting new interactive feature. In any region in Appalachia, you'll now be able to cast off and reel in a plethora of fish.* | 
| | *C.A.M.P. Revamp*September 2, 2025 ***C.A.M.P. Revamp*** is the twenty-fourth major update for*Fallout 76* .*Relaxed Build Rules let C.A.M.P. creatives to let their imaginations run wild. With reduced restrictions on what you can place in your home base, enjoy building all kinds of C.A.M.P.s!* | 
| | *Burning Springs*December 2, 2025 ***Burning Springs*** is the twenty-fifth major update for*Fallout 76* .*A new region of the map is opening for those with enough grit to cross Point Pleasant bridge. It's time for you to travel westward towards Burning Springs. Taking place in rural Ohio, this is our largest map expansion to Fallout 76 yet!* | 
| | *The Backwoods*March 3, 2026 ***The Backwoods*** is the twenty-sixth major update for*Fallout 76* .*Listen closely, do you hear that? The Appalachian wasteland is calling your name! The Backwoods update is arriving and brings a load of great changes to the region.* | 
| | *Infestations*June 2, 2026 ***Infestations*** is the twenty-seventh major update for*Fallout 76* .*Appalachia is in danger! Infestations of enemies are taking over locations, and the Wasteland needs YOU to clear them out.* | 

### Upcoming updates[]

As of 2026, *Fallout 76* for the most part follows a standard schedule of a major update release and a subsequent supporting patch, with approximately four of these major release cycles per year (in spring, summer, autumn and winter). This accounts for eight patches per year: four titled releases, and four bug-fix patches supporting each of the titled releases. Game director Jonathan Rush stated in March 2026 that summer and winter releases are meant for large new content drops, while those in spring and fall are intended for improving pre-existing content. [1] 

Among the upcoming releases for *Fallout 76* is a "part two" to the story of the *Burning Springs* update, as Bethesda Game Studios have confirmed *Burning Springs* is only the first entry in a story spanning multiple chapters and updates. [2] Certain areas of the Burning Springs region are inaccessible behind invisible barriers, potentially for future content, as the development team has stated they would prefer to reserve areas for the future, rather than bulldoze player C.A.M.P.s when new content is added to existing areas. [3] 

During the Fallout Day Broadcast on October 23, 2025, Rush and Bill LaCoste announced that an update in 2026 would feature hardware improvements for *Fallout 76* on PS5 and Xbox Series X. [4] 

In March 2026, Rush alluded to patch 76 being a major update for *Fallout 76*, claiming that "heads are going to explode" when it is able to be revealed; [1] prior to this, patch 76 being a milestone update was first teased in October 2025. [5] Under the game's current schedule, patch 76 would tentatively fall within summer 2027.

In April 2026, Rush said *Fallout 76* has "plans for years down the road" and the development team has "more ideas than what we know what to do with." [6] 

*Raven Rock*, an upcoming major update, is currently set for release some time in 2027. It was announced by Bethesda Game Studios on July 17, 2026, alongside several other new *Fallout* titles. *Raven Rock* was described as a "prequel story" to *Fallout 3*. [7] 

## Updates calendar[]

## Roadmaps[]

From 2019 to 2022, Bethesda Softworks released an annual roadmap of *Fallout 76* updates for the year, typically with one major update per season (spring, summer, autumn, winter).

- The 2019 roadmap was released on February 21, 2019. [8] 
- The 2020 roadmap was released on May 14, 2020. [9] It was updated in September of that year to reflect changes to the release schedule, seen in the gallery.
- The 2021 roadmap was released on March 22, 2021. [10] It was also updated that September to reflect changes (see gallery).
- The 2022 roadmap was released on February 21, 2022. [11] 
- No roadmap was released for any year including and after 2023. Since 2023, future updates have mostly been teased through the seasonal community calendars.
